pages.title: Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Explains the modular architecture, ownership boundaries, and the core data/control flow that connects document loaders, extractors, LLM wrappers, splitters, processes, and evaluation components.
instructions: Describe how Async processing and interceptor hooks are wired.
Describe the ownership boundaries among Extractor, Process, DocumentLoader, LLM, Splitter, and Eval modules.
Explain how vision mode changes the flow (images vs text).
Trace the end-to-end control/data flow: loader.load -> universal format -> _extract -> LLM request -> validated Contract.

pages.title: Completion Strategies for Large Documents
pages.purpose: Explains how ExtractThinker handles incomplete or truncated LLM output for large documents via CompletionStrategy (FORBIDDEN, PAGINATE, CONCATENATE) and the PaginationHandler/ConcatenationHandler implementations.
instructions: Explain ConcatenationHandler: raw completion streaming, JSON continuation retries, JSON assembly and model validation.

Explain PaginationHandler: per-page parallel extraction, optional-field response model, list and scalar merge logic, conflict detection and LLM-based conflict resolution, partial response continuation.
Explain the CompletionStrategy enum and when each is used.

pages.title: Contracts and Classification
pages.purpose: Explains the Contract BaseModel schema-typing patternched, Classification objects, ClassificationResponse, classification strategies, classification trees, and document sub-classification via splitting.
instructions: Explain Classification fields (name, description, contract, extraction_contract, image, extractor, uuid) and its validation rules.
Explain ClassificationResponse and ClassificationResponseInternal (name, confidence 1-10, classification).
Explain ClassificationStrategy enum (CONSENSUS, HIGHER_ORDER, CONSENSUS_WITH_THRESHOLD).
Explain ClassificationTree/Node and the level-by-level hierarchical classification flow in Process._classify_tree_async.
Explain Contract as a Pydantic BaseModel marker used to type extraction outputs.

pages.title: Document Loaders
pages.purpose: Explains the DocumentLoader abstraction, the 'page-based' universal load format, caching, vision-mode handling, and inventories each concrete loader with its purpose and supported formats.
instructions: Describe the abstract DocumentLoader contract: can_handle, load, can_handle_vision, can_handle_paginate, convert_to_images, vision mode flags.
Explain TTLCache caching semantics and how vision_mode participates in cache keys.
Explain the standard page dict format {content, image, tables, forms, ...} used by all loaders.

Inventory concrete loaders (Tesseract, PyPdf, PdfPlumber, Spreadsheet, AzureDocumentIntelligence, AWSTextract, GoogleDocumentAI, MistralOCR, LLMImage, Data, TXT, Doc2txt, Docling, BeautifulSoup, MarkItDown, EasyOCR) with their SUPPORTED_FORMATS.

pages.title: Evaluation and Quality Metrics
pages.purpose: Explains the evaluation subsystem for measuring extraction quality: Evaluator, datasets, field/document/schema/time metrics, comparison strategies, hallucination detection, cost tracking, teacher-student comparison, and the evaluation CLI.
instructions: Explain EvaluationDataset and FileSystemDataset semantics.
Explain Evaluator.evaluate flow and metrics (FieldMetrics, DocumentMetrics, SchemaValidationMetrics, ExecutionTimeMetrics).
Explain TeacherStudentEvaluator comparative reporting.
Explain cost metrics via litellm token_counter/completion_cost.
Explain field comparison types (EXACT, FUZZY, SEMANTIC, NUMERIC, CUSTOM) and thresholds.
Explain hallucination detection (LLM/heuristic strategies, Confident AI approach).
Explain the CLI (extract_thinker-eval) and its config file format.

pages.title: Extractor and Extraction Pipeline
pages.purpose: Explains the Extractor component and the full extraction pipeline including source resolution, content loading, universal format mapping, LLM invocation, completion strategies, vision error handling, and batch extraction.
instructions: Explain _extract flow, _build_message_content, vision vs text paths, and extra_content.
Explain _extract_with_splitting, split_content token budgeting, and aggregate_results.
Explain _map_to_universal_format normalization of loader output (pages list, string, dict).
Explain extract_batch and the BatchJob lifecycle.
Explain source resolution (document_loader / document_loaders_by_file_type / capability fallback / DocumentLoaderData / allow_vision fallback).
Explain vision error classification (is_vision_error, classify_vision_error).

pages.title: LLM Integration
pages.purpose: Explains the LLM wrapper that unifies model backends (LiteLLM/instructor and pydantic-ai), request paths, thinking mode, token budgets, dynamic prompts, routers, and timeouts.
instructions: Explain LLMEngine enum (DEFAULT/LiteLLM+instructor, PYDANTIC_AI).
Explain dynamic parsing (is_dynamic, build_dynamic_prompt, extract_thinking_json).
Explain global_models helper functions.
Explain request/raw_completion paths, response_model handling, thinking mode, set_page_count, token/thinking budget calculation, temperature, timeout, router usage.

pages.title: Markdown Conversion
pages.purpose: Explains the MarkdownConverter component that converts documents to Markdown, including the structured and plain conversion modes, vision processing, page selection, and fallback behavior.
instructions: Explain _process_page_with_llm, _build_messages, vision flag handling, placeholder handling, and _basic_to_markdown fallback.
Explain async variants.
Explain to_markdown and to_markdown_structured, DEFAULT_PAGE_PROMPT/DEFAULT_MARKDOWN_PROMPT, PageContent/ContentItem models.

pages.title: Domain Model Objects
pages.purpose: Catalogues and explains the supporting domain model objects: DocGroup, DocGroups2, EagerDocGroup, Classification, ClassificationResponse, Contracts, splitting/completion strategy enums, and other supporting data models.
instructions: Explain DocGroup (pages list, classification), DocGroups container, DocGroups2 (belongs_to_same_document, classification_page1/2), EagerDocGroup and DocGroupsEager (reasoning, groupOfDocuments).
Explain how these are used by splitters and Process.

pages.title: Process and Document Splitting
pages.purpose: Explains the Process component that chains file loading, document splitting under classifications, and per-group extraction; and the Splitter abstractions (ImageSplitter, TextSplitter) with eager and lazy strategies.
instructions: Explain ImageSplitter and TextSplitter LLM-based page comparisons and their conservative fallback behavior.
Explain Process state machine: load_document_loader, set_document_loader_for_file_type, load_splitter, add_classify_extractor, load_file, split, extract.
Explain SplittingStrategy.EAGER and LAZY and the splitter contract (belongs_to_same_document, split_eager_doc_group, split_lazy_doc_group, aggregate_doc_groups).
Explain classification strategies in Process.classify / classify_async and _classify_tree_async.

pages.title: Change Guide for Maintainers
pages.purpose: Focused change guides for representative maintenance tasks: adding a new document loader, adding a completion strategy, modifying the LLM wrapper, changing evaluation logic, and adding tests.
instructions: Explain test conventions using tests/ directory examples.
Explain the extension seams: loading a new DocumentLoader subclass, the interceptor hooks, LLM backend abstraction, and completion handler strategy interface.
Provide concrete, source-grounded steps for each maintenance task.

pages.title: Batch Extraction and Management
pages.purpose: Explains the asynchronous batch extraction path (Extractor.extract_batch), the BatchJob lifecycle for OpenAI batch API, and file lifecycle management.
instructions: Describe the model constraints (BATCH_SUPPORTED_MODELS, no pydantic-ai).
Explain message generation, JSONL file creation (_add_method_to_file), upload, batch creation, status polling, result parsing, cleanup, and __del__ cleanup.

pages.title: Configuration, Installation, and CI
pages.purpose: Explains project configuration for development and operations: pyproject.toml packaging, dependency groups, lint/format tooling (.ruff.toml, .flake8, pre-commit), and CI workflows.
instructions: Explain GitHub Actions workflows and their purposes.
Explain Python/package configuration and core dependencies in pyproject.toml.
Explain lint/tooling config (.ruff.toml, .flake8, .pre-commit).

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: A practical quickstart for engineers to install, configure, and run their first extraction and classification workflows using ExtractThinker.
instructions: Cover installation via pip, basic library imports, the minimal 'load loader + load LLM + extract(Contract)' flow, a classification example, and a Process/splitting example.
Reference concrete public API exported from extract_thinker/__init__.py.
